title: Redesign online payment flow
description: Checkout marks online provider payments as authorized; webhook settles them correctly and posts balanced ledger
completion: Redesigned online payment flow: checkout now marks payments with a provider as 'authorized' and sets order to 'pending' (deferring stock/kitchen/loyalty/ledger/receipt). Created confirmOrderPayment service that runs full confirmation (stock decrement, kitchen ticket, loyalty, ledger, receipt, mark paid). Webhook now calls confirmOrderPayment on settlement instead of only posting ledger.
